acknowledgement.en: That is something our HR team should handle directly. I will connect you to a confidential HR line.
acknowledgement.es: Eso es algo que nuestro equipo de Recursos Humanos debe atender directamente. Le conectaré con una línea confidencial de Recursos Humanos.

afterHours.en: Our confidential HR line is closed right now. You can reach the Contoso ethics hotline any time at the number I will send you, or I can ask HR to call you back next business day.

safety.en: If you are in danger or thinking about harming yourself, please call your local emergency number or a crisis line now. You can also call the Contoso EAP at 1-800-555-0100. This is not a crisis line.
